overview: Netherbian Faultline is the seismic rupture beneath Shadeweaver’s Thicket, where burrow tunnels collapse into caverns and Netherbian creatures emerge.
history: Seismic activity beneath Luclin opened the first faultline.
Netherbian burrowers tunneled upward into the thicket.
Corruption spread through collapsed tunnels and root networks.
Grimling raiders attempted to use the faultline but were driven out.
Vah Shir scouts reported hive-like activity deeper underground.
hooks: A new burrow queen begins forming deeper in the faultline.
Seismic cracks widen, threatening the thicket above.
Netherbian skitterer swarms erupt from collapsed tunnels.
Shadow corruption spreads through underground roots.
